actions.description: Run the governed full rebuild, commit valid generated changes, and trigger the existing deployment chain.

actions.description: Rebuild machine-readable answer, sitemap, feed, Atlas, and LLM surfaces; validate them; and commit changes.
actions.confirmation: Refresh and publish all machine-readable authority surfaces?

actions.label: Submit Updated Pages
actions.description: Prepare current distribution artifacts and submit eligible URLs through the configured IndexNow path.
actions.confirmation: Submit the current eligible URL set to configured search endpoints?

actions.label: Run Self-Healing
actions.description: Run the canonical generated-content and citation self-healing chain, then commit only validated repairs.
actions.confirmation: Run automatic repair and publish valid fixes?

actions.label: Fix Failed Pages
actions.description: Run targeted repair, Safe Harbor review, ownership validation, and finalization against eligible non-agent pages.
actions.confirmation: Repair eligible failed pages now? Protected paid-agent pages will not be edited.

actions.label: Rerun Distribution
actions.description: Rebuild and deploy current distribution artifacts without regenerating content.
actions.confirmation: Rerun distribution for the current validated site?

actions.label: Pause Automation
actions.description: Pause autonomous publishing while preserving diagnostics and read-only reporting.

actions.label: Resume Automation
actions.description: Resume scheduled autonomous publishing using the current growth setting.

actions.label: Set Growth Speed: Normal
actions.description: Set conservative daily content budgets. These are targets, not hard validation gates.

actions.label: Set Growth Speed: Aggressive
actions.description: Restore the approved aggressive 100K operating cadence.

actions.label: Set Growth Speed: Maximum
actions.description: Use the highest approved target budgets while retaining Safe Harbor and ownership protections.

actions.label: Refresh This Dashboard
actions.description: Rebuild admin snapshots from current repository truth and commit the refreshed dashboard.

actions.label: Emergency Stop
actions.description: Stop autonomous mutation and publishing immediately while retaining proof and diagnostics.
